libraryPanels.title: Library panels
libraryPanels.lead: Library panels are kept once in a folder and shown by many dashboards. A change shows on every one of them. Rights follow the folder.
libraryPanels.emptyText: Turn a panel into a library panel in its editor, then add it to other dashboards.
libraryPanels.makeHint: The panel is kept in the library and this dashboard shows it from there. Other dashboards can add it too.
libraryPanels.name: Name
libraryPanels.linkedHint: This panel shows the library panel “{name}”. Changes to its queries and look change it on every dashboard.
libraryPanels.unlink: Keep as a panel of this dashboard only
libraryPanels.saveWarning: “{name}” is shown by {count} dashboards. The change shows on all of them at once.
libraryPanels.changed: Someone changed this library panel in the meantime. Close the editor and open it again.
libraryPanels.inUse: Dashboards still show this library panel; remove it from them first.
